authorization.provenance: User to Codex following audit 118 and the recorded review disposition.

scope: Accept S1-LL21-a production D2 code materialization at the reviewed scope.
exclusions: Engine identity in D2 records is declared provenance; install does not detect the executing engine. Qualification joins executable hashes.
Atomics admission has no per-profile filter; wait/notify remain banned and this generated corpus has no atomic instructions.
Record comparison is JSON key-order sensitive: reserialized records may refuse.
Imported global parsing supports the generated two-byte type/mutability shape; multi-byte typed references refuse.
Code materialization only: no unshared runtime services, browser, JSPI or packaging qualification.
Only the full/shared and precompiled-callback/unshared code profiles. JSPI stays deferred under the Stage 1 entry decision.
Node/V8 is executed at exactly the S0-ENGINE-a tool pins. No new browser engine qualification or cross-Worker runtime ownership is claimed.
No wait/notify or legacy exception instructions in templates. No start, data, element, defined memory/table/global or tag sections admitted by the generated-module reader.

Runtime services such as the collector and numeric service are still emitted for their own profiles. This does not make their shared-memory binaries usable in unshared memory or qualify a complete unshared image.

The unshared binary has the same digest as its template because the bytes are identical. Its installation record still binds the final binary role and profile; a shared installation refuses template bytes or template identity.
The inherited pool snapshot transport is a fixture, not LL14 cross-dump or the production image loader. No module-granularity or performance claim.
